technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) novelty 9 是专用模型和宿主的集成。[Q02](#research-q02) mechanism 15 是把恢复出口与自动化分开，未验证旧任务迁移。transferability 10 的混配和运行期守卫可迁到多宿主扩展。[Q03](#research-q03) simplification 4 集中授权，仍有宿主组合与账号维护。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) workflow 18 将同一任务保留在宿主会话，delivery 0 仍交付用户既有工作成果。reach 5 允许符合资格的宿主用户接入，不能证明额外账号覆盖。[Q03](#research-q03) economics 4 可能少搬运上下文，服务费用及排障未知。

recommendation.reason: 已有合适授权的 DSH 开发者可以先在独立 profile 核对包身份，再验证一次小型 Codex 任务。相比另开客户端再搬运上下文，它把模型接入现有宿主会话。若宿主版本、授权或退出不能验证，应恢复原模型和 profile。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README.md:13–15 与 65–69 支持宿主内选模型的具体任务，超过8分潜在用途，重复成本未量化低于23分。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) src/index.ts:475–510 显示实际路由，超过6分界面包装，但工具与账户效用未验证低于19分。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) src/adapter.ts:114–138 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 宿主策略第7–31行覆盖认证流及限制，超过6分声明。作者回归不是本轮实际验证，低于19分。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) README.md:126–156 和 src/store.ts:246–260 明确凭据遗留和退路，高于5分无退出。宿主组合与认证持续成本未知低于15分。

data.reports:
# Codex Connect > 为 DSH 增加 ChatGPT OAuth 授权的 Codex 模型路由及可选辅助能力。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect) - **版本号**：0.2.0-alpha.12（[固定提交 674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/tree/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-04（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定提交源码与作者兼容报告分开记录。未运行安装、OAuth、模型或 Desktop。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要在 DSH 会话中使用 Codex 模型并保留宿主工具流程的开发者。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 将 OAuth 模型纳入既有宿主模型选择和 Agent 流程。[Q02](#research-q02) 任务守卫单独限制指定宿主的自动化。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) 精确宿主矩阵、旧任务恢复和真实账号权限是三个验收范围。 - **建议**：[Q04](#research-q04) 将目录、包兼容与账户权限分开显示并验证是否减少误判。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 先做无钥匙诊断再决定是否授权。[Q02](#research-q02) 指定恢复宿主的旧任务按只读、停止或手动接管流程单独验收。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 将 OAuth 模型纳入既有宿主模型选择和 Agent 流程。[Q02](#research-q02) 任务守卫单独限制指定宿主的自动化。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) 精确宿主矩阵、旧任务恢复和真实账号权限是三个验收范围。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q04](#research-q04) 将目录、包兼容与账户权限分开显示并验证是否减少误判。 在隔离 profile 验证实际包组、路由冲突、普通请求、停止和注销。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要在 DSH 会话中使用 Codex 模型并保留宿主工具流程的开发者。 沿用现有 DSH 模型，或在独立 Codex 客户端处理并手工搬运任务。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | |---|---|---|---| | 一致的 DSH 包组 | 挂载必需 | 注册宿主模型 | 诊断后恢复原配置 | | 获授权 ChatGPT 账号 | 真实模型必需 | 提供 OAuth | 仅保留本地核查 | | 无同名 provider | 挂载必需 | 避免冲突 | 保留原路由 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 诊断 | 用户确认包及 profile | 未知时暂停 | | 授权 | 用户在浏览器亲自确认 | 失败时保护已有凭据 | | 试用 | 用户提交固定任务 | 核对工具和取消 | | 退出 | 用户切回原路由，按需注销 | 确认凭据处理结果 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | |---|---|---|---| | 首次 | 账号及宿主费用未知 | 核对版本和授权 | 未测试 | | 持续 | 额度消耗未知 | 维护版本和错误诊断 | 取决于实际账号 | | 失败恢复 | 重试及恢复成本未知 | 处理冲突、退出和凭据 | 未运行 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | |---|---|---| | 模型接入 | 适配器在宿主注册 | 账号及效果 | | 任务恢复 | 指定版本有独立守卫 | 历史任务迁移 | | 账户退出 | 独立存储与备份 | 本机残留 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：在保留 DSH Agent 流程的前提下，插件实际接入哪些 Codex 能力，如何确认边界？ ### Q01 · 模型调用与宿主 Agent 怎样分工？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 需要在 DSH 的工具与会话流程内选用 Codex 模型的人，可通过额外的 openai-codex 路由让现有宿主发出模型请求。相对另开 Codex 客户端再手工搬运上下文，这个入口将模型纳入同一选择流程。代码检查已注册的同名 provider，再创建认证和适配器，注册到 ctx.llm。适配器用当前 credential 提供 OAuth key，把模型上下文和选项送入 provider streamSimple，能走诊断 fetch 和配置代理。开发者仍须亲自完成授权并以实际模型可用性作为验收，目录中的条目不能替代账户权限。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:13-15](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/README.md#L13-L15) 作者界定模型路由与宿主职责 ```text Community Alpha — not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, ChatGPT, Codex, DeepSeek, or DeepSeek Harness. Codex Connect adds the `openai-codex` model provider to the normal Harness agent loop. Harness continues to manage tools, permissions, approvals, attachments, session persistence, compaction, and recovery. Installing the plugin does not change your default model or search route, and it does not turn a ChatGPT subscription into an OpenAI Platform API key. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:475-510](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/src/index.ts#L475-L510) 冲突检查和 LLM 路由接线

() => resolveOpenAICodexSettings(current()).enableNativeCompaction, backendRequests, taskRuntime, () => resolveOpenAICodexSettings(current()).enableImageGeneration, config.preflightActivity, config.retryPolicy, () => resolveOpenAICodexSettings(current()).reasoningEffort, ) ctx.llm.registerAdapter([OPENAI_CODEX_PROVIDER], adapter) ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/adapter.ts:114-138](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/src/adapter.ts#L114-L138) 流与 OAuth 认证进入供应商适配器

**依据 4 · 作者声明**：[README.md:65-69](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/README.md#L65-L69) 交互授权要求 ```text ### 2. Authorize and select a model Open **Settings → Models → Openai-Codex → Authorize**, then complete approval yourself in the browser. If an embedded window is blocked, select **Open ChatGPT sign-in page**. Choose an `openai-codex` model in the normal Harness model picker. Never paste an authorization URL, code, token, or account identifier into an issue, log, chat, or configuration file. For a browser on another device, the optional manual callback form can complete the pending login without forwarding the localhost callback port; follow [Remote browser authorization](docs/reference.md#remote-browser-authorization). ``` #### 缺口 - 未执行 OAuth 和模型请求，也未对照独立客户端 **影响**：无法确定模型可用性、工具恢复和效率 **进一步探讨**：在获授权的隔离 DSH 会话中用固定文本、工具与取消任务对照 ### Q02 · 兼容是否等于任务自动化可用？ **研究主题**：工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 固定文档列出插件 alpha.12 的一组精确宿主版本，作者报告无钥匙安装及运行回归。它是宿主构造的证据，不能代替 OAuth 或 Desktop 真实接受。任务策略读取 agent、agent-loop、tools 的包版本。只要其中出现 0.2.2-alpha.3 而其余不全相同就报版本不匹配，全相同进入仅恢复模式。对其他宿主，自动化守卫还看 Tools.prototype.presentAs。这个限制的范围是任务自动化，普通模型路由的存在与旧任务可读都不提供自动激活依据。测试范围内也应区分版本矩阵与实际安装包解析。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:23-30](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/README.md#L23-L30) 精确版本声明和账号条件 ```text This guide recommends Codex Connect `0.2.0-alpha.12` / DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`; the other exact supported hosts are listed below. Check `dsh --version` first and use `doctor --json` for local diagnostics; the CLI version alone does not prove which model-runtime packages are installed, and missing metadata is reported as unknown. For other versions, use [Installation and upgrades](INSTALL.md). A moving npm tag such as `alpha` is not a compatibility guarantee. | Requirement | Verified pairing | |---|---| | Codex Connect | `0.2.0-alpha.12` | | DeepSeek Harness | `0.1.7-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.1`, `0.2.1-alpha.2`, `0.2.1-alpha.3`, `0.2.1-alpha.4`, `0.2.1-alpha.5`, `0.2.1-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.4`, `0.2.1-rc.5` or `0.2.2-alpha.3` (consistent package set) | | Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | | Account | ChatGPT OAuth with access to the requested Codex model; availability is decided by OpenAI | ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:48-54](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/README.md#L48-L54) 作者报告的无钥匙验证与真实环境缺口 ```text Historical release [`0.2.0-alpha.1`](docs/release-notes/0.2.0-alpha.1.md) adds `gpt-6.1-sol` through a model-catalog fallback and begins the shorter independent plugin numbering. The four supported DSH versions are unchanged; no host upgrade is required. It retains Alpha 4.54's handling of initial system instructions and tool definitions on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, diagnostics for differing host/plugin provider libraries, and Canary's normal-request checks, along with Alpha 4.53's core maintenance changes, existing-task recovery and safety, and 4.52's [opt-in local request metrics](docs/request-metrics.md). Collection stays off until a private directory is configured; unknown usage is not zero. No Task reopening or model-library/OAuth upgrade is included. The package passed keyless installation/runtime regression on all fifteen exact DSH versions above. Task controls remain paused: activation is rejected and existing current-host browser regressions show no controls in fresh Sessions. These checks do not establish live OAuth, real-account image editing, authenticated browser acceptance on the new host, or full user acceptance; migration of earlier Task grants across a Harness upgrade is not verified. Older supported pairings and their task behavior are documented in [Installation and upgrades](INSTALL.md). Historically, on 2026-10-10 the maintainer reported successful login and normal use on Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` with the identified local adaptation build. Only the historical `0.2.0-alpha.3` client was compared with that local adaptation and found to differ only by the package-version string. This comparison does not establish `0.2.0-alpha.4` Desktop or live-account acceptance, nor acceptance of later npm artifacts; no new real Desktop acceptance was performed. See the [Desktop acceptance record](INSTALL.md#official-desktop). ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/adaptive-task-host-policy.ts:7-31](https://github.com/franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect/blob/674af2699af2755619e130081e26dd8b3d37f371/src/adaptive-task-host-policy.ts#L7-L31) 精确宿主元数据、混配拒绝及自动化守卫
查看原文（25行） ```text export const TASK_HOST_RECOVERY_ONLY = 'TASK_HOST_RECOVERY_ONLY' const require = createRequire(import.meta.url) const packages = ['@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'] as const /** Read package metadata only; alpha.3's existing records retain safety exits, never automation. */ export function taskHostRecoveryOnly(): boolean { const versions = packages.map(name => { try { const metadata: unknown = JSON.parse(readFileSync(require.resolve(name + '/package.json'), 'utf8')) if (metadata !== null && typeof metadata === 'object' && 'name' in metadata && metadata.name === name && 'version' in metadata && typeof metadata.version === 'string') return metadata.version } catch { /* Missing metadata cannot manufacture an alpha.3 match. */ } return undefined }) if (!versions.includes('0.2.2-alpha.3')) return false if (!versions.every(version => version === '0.2.2-alpha.3')) taskFailure('TASK_HOST_VERSION_MISMATCH') return true } export function assertTaskHostAutomation(): void { if (taskHostRecoveryOnly()) taskFailure(TASK_HOST_RECOVERY_ONLY) // Unknown/new executor-only runtimes must not regain automation merely because // their package metadata is unavailable. Recovery exits do not use this guard. if (typeof Reflect.get(Tools.prototype, 'presentAs') !== 'function') taskFailure('TASK_HOST_AUTOMATION_UNVERIFIED') } ```

Normal browser account responses return account summaries, not raw tokens. A remote browser device is not necessarily the DSH host. ### Does uninstalling sign me out? No. OAuth state is stored separately at `$DSH_HOME/.openai-codex-auth.json` (`~/.dsh` by default). The plugin does not copy or modify `~/.codex/auth.json`. Use **Sign out all accounts**, or `logout` before uninstalling, only when deleting credentials is intentional. ### Can I switch accounts for different conversations? Subsequent Codex requests use the selected active account; conversations do not bind their own accounts. Fast Mode is conversation-scoped. Cancelling a new authorization preserves existing accounts; an explicit revoked-refresh response asks for reauthorization, while temporary failures preserve the account for retry. See [Account behavior](docs/reference.md#accounts-models-and-quota). ### Why does a listed model fail? Model HTTP/SSE failures include bounded, request-local diagnostic metadata after the existing error message. An `overloaded` message alone does not establish an account block. See [persistent-error diagnostics](docs/experiments/issue-219-diagnostics.md) for scope and reproduction. Account permissions, plugin/host compatibility, and network conditions all affect availability. Access on another client does not guarantee this integration will work. OpenAI controls model access, quota, context capacity, and service behavior; catalog entries are not proof of entitlement. ```
